title: Reading a store name
content: I became aware I was in the mall last night, and I got very excited because I haven't been in a while. I was with a friend (I don't know who irl) and we were walking by a bar when I recognized the bar. I knew the name but can't remember what it was now. When I saw the bar I knew I was in the mall, near the stores, so I grabbed my friend's hand to drag her over to them. I saw a store like Claire's, and read the name above the store. It said "Prospects." I was aware at the time that I usually cannot read in dreams. So I asked her to read it, and she said the same thing. I read it again and it still said "Prospects". I know this is very unusual for dreaming. I pulled my friend into the store and had her read a couple of signs that I could see. I don't remember what those were now either. I was excited to be in the mall, and I wanted to go explore, but being in Prospects was the last thing I remember. I wish I could spend more time in the mall.
